sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the major maintenance procedures 
P1, which must be performed every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title 
block.

Steam transformer system
also knows as reboiler system is used for
Mazout oil heating purposes by steam.

المسودة الأولى بدأها المهندس. جمال El-Sayed 
El-Osily, reviewed by maintenance manger eng. Sobhey Abdel Haleem، تمت مراجعته بواسطة 
EDEPC التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة المهندس. Samir
Abd-Elgalil, accepted by eng. Mohamed Abdel Khaffar
Al-Arish Power Station general manager, approved by 
eng Yousry Mohamed Salama head sector and certified by eng Aly Mostafa Al Lethy 
EDEPC inspection &quality control head sector.

Safety 
Precaution

A work permit must be issued; the qualified maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminal of the pump motor

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction
valves
Be sure pump must be completely drainage.

sections.text:
Work to be
Carried out
التفكيك
محاذاة الفرخ ومقارنتها مع قيم الإعداد

قم بتفكيك جميع الأنابيب المرفقة بالجهاز pump
.
Unscrew motor bolts and take it out .

Lift pump from its place to the work place
.

قم بإزالة كافة الأنابيب المساعدة و piping
.
Drain the lubricating oil from the bearing housing (240) .
تطابق علامة لكمة نصفي اقتران.

Disconnect the two halves coupling and remove coupling
spacer (399).

قم بإزالة الصواميل السداسية من مسامير الغلاف التي تحمل
فانوس (248) قوس لمضخة الغلاف (105) .

Screw the release bolts provided in casing L turn bolts
evenly through a quarter turn at both side.

Slightly pull out the driving unit till impeller (153)
clear the pump casing (105) .
Remove casing gasket (511).
Unscrew the impeller nut (330).

Remove the gasket between impeller and impeller nut
(582) and take out the impeller.
Pull shaft sleeve (515) under mech. Seal.

Remove mech. Seal from shaft sleeve and keep it in
clean place.

Take out the casing cover along with the mech. Seal
cover from casing (220).
Take out liquid deflector (236).
Remove the bearing with puller.

sections.text: تقتيش
Inspect the bearings and replace them if necessary.
Replace the worn out parts.
Check all parts for any worn out.
Check all parts for cracks.
Inspect the run out of shaft.
Change mech. Seal surfaces for wear and tear for moving and fixed parts.

sections.text: Reassemble
Before reassembly all parts should be cleaned .

قم بتركيب زوج محامل كروية التلامس الزاوي مرة أخرى على المحمل الأسطواني
(264) في نهاية غير القيادة.
Tighten bearing lock nut (336).
فحص رمح جنبا إلى جنب مع تحمل.

Mount bearing cartridge (241) on bearing housing at driving end and
tighten it.
Mount mech. Seal (315).
Mount impeller on shaft and keep the cleaner between impeller worn plant.
Mount the electrical motor.
Mount the two haves coupling.
Adjust alignment between pump and motor
Mount all auxiliary tubing and piping.
Mount suction and delivery tubes.
Fill bearing house with oil to suitable level

sections.text: Stating of Pump

Chick the direction of rotation of motor before
starting.
Open the inlet and outlet valves of mech. Seal the cooling water.

Open the delivery valve after the pump has been started to operate at
its full speed.
